records.claim: Malefic ninth-house and ninth-lord factors are linked to 'sinful' behavior in the translation.

methodological_flags: Do not conflate ascetic status, devotional faith, practices, samadhi, moksha and spiritual institution leadership.
Some semantically overlapping passages explicitly derive from Brihat Jataka and Saravali; these are dependencies, not independent forecasts.
Rath's Theory and Sastri/Bhasin/Portuguese editor notes are separate from claimed ancient verse.
Do not choose among conflicting translations or conflict-resolution rules after observing life histories.
Culturally loaded moral and metaphysical assertions require different measurement limits from observable behaviors.
